plot: As Taekyung leaves ahead of the slower Jin Family forces, Wikyung and the gathered family members and allies send him off with pride. Mukyung promises to catch up and urges Taekyung not to fall to anyone else before then.

Elsewhere, Mae Jonghak and Song Ho recall the Martial God’s charge to protect their place, convictions, and the world. Zhuge Feng reports that the Zhuge Clan has completed all its assigned tasks, marking the start of an all-out war.

active_continuity: Taekyung has left ahead of the Jin Family’s larger force; the family and its allies remain behind to move with the army.

Dark Heaven’s forces are advancing from Xinjiang; Qinghai and the Kunlun Sect are considered likely targets.

open_questions: What is the objective behind Dark Heaven’s advance from Xinjiang, and where will its forces strike?
What caused the System malfunction, and is it connected to the Lord of Heaven?
